How do I use it properly the very first time?

Here's how to use your Oura Ring 5 properly on your very first day:

Initial Setup:



Download the Oura App from the App Store or Google Play


Put your ring on the charger until the LED blinks blue (this means it's ready to pair)


Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on your phone, then follow the in-app setup instructions to create your account and pair your ring



Proper Wearing:
Wear your ring with the dimple facing the palm side of your finger on your index, middle, or ring finger for best signal quality. Make sure it fits snugly but comfortably - you should be able to make a fist without gaps between the ring and finger

First Night is Key:
You'll need to sleep with your ring on for at least one full night to start receiving Sleep and Readiness Scores the next morning. Activity data will be available immediately, but sleep data requires that first night

Be Patient with Data:
Oura will spend the next few weeks learning your unique patterns to provide personalized insights, so don't worry if the guidance seems generic at first - it gets much more tailored as it learns about you
